name: theta <= candidate index, no mixing or anticlustering
source: KS20 Lemma 7.5.4, as described by BKW (2024); KS20 itself not consulted
scope_note: Stationarity, a spectral tail process and existence of theta for |X| only.

name: The gap formula: cluster ratio -> L iff late-return mass = candidate index - L
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralTailProcess.tendsto_clusterRatio_iff.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℤ → Ω → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {Θ : ℤ → Ω' → ℝ} {u : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℕ} (hα : 0 < α)
  (hX : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (X t)) (hΘm : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Θ t))
  (hstat : ExtremeValueTheory.HasShiftInvariantWindows P X)
  (h : ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralTailProcess P X α Q Θ)
  (hu : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hr : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) (L : ℝ) :
  Filter.Tendsto (ExtremeValueTheory.clusterRatio P X u r) Filter.atTop (nhds L) ↔
    ExtremeValueTheory.HasLateReturnMass P X u r
      ((ExtremeValueTheory.candidateExtremalIndex Q Θ α).toReal - L)
scope_note: No anticlustering, mixing or r_n/n -> 0. Late-return mass is the library's own notion.

name: An explicit stationary process with theta = 1/2 < candidate index = 1
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.logEchoProcess_theta_lt_vartheta.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) :
  ExtremeValueTheory.HasShiftInvariantWindows P
      (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) ∧
    ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralTailProcess P
        (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) α
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ()) ExtremeValueTheory.unitSpectral ∧
      (ExtremeValueTheory.candidateExtremalIndex (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ())
              ExtremeValueTheory.unitSpectral α).toReal =
          1 ∧
        ExtremeValueTheory.HasExtremalIndex
          (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k) P (1 / 2)
scope_note: An example, with iid Pareto(1, alpha) noise, assumed nonnegative at every point (a null-set normalization).

name: Block-length phase transition of the log-echo process
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.logEchoProcess_phase_transition.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) {u : ℕ → ℝ} {τ : ℝ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ)
  (hτ :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z 0 ω})
      Filter.atTop (nhds τ))
  (r : ℕ → ℕ) :
  (Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / Real.log ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        Filter.Tendsto
            (ExtremeValueTheory.clusterRatio P
              (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 1) ∧
          ExtremeValueTheory.HasLateReturnMass P
            (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r 0) ∧
    (∀ (c : ℝ),
        0 < c →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / Real.log ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds c) →
            Filter.Tendsto
                (ExtremeValueTheory.clusterRatio P
                  (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r)
                Filter.atTop (nhds ((1 + min (1 / (c * α)) 1) / 2)) ∧
              ExtremeValueTheory.HasLateReturnMass P
                (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r
                ((1 - min (1 / (c * α)) 1) / 2)) ∧
      (Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log ↑n / ↑(r n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            Filter.Tendsto
                (ExtremeValueTheory.clusterRatio P
                  (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r)
                Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 2)) ∧
              ExtremeValueTheory.HasLateReturnMass P
                (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r (1 / 2))
scope_note: For r_n of order log n. Same noise as log-echo-theta-lt-vartheta.

name: A mixture with no extremal index
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.not_hasExtremalIndex_mixture.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ}
  {E : Set Ω} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
  (hEZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.Indep (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom {E})
      (ExtremeValueTheory.innovationSigma Z) P)
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hp0 : 0 < P.real E) (hp1 : P.real E < 1) (θ : ℝ) :
  ¬ExtremeValueTheory.HasExtremalIndex (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z ↑k) P θ

name: Answer to Bai-Kulik-Wang: anticlustering iff rho < gamma/alpha
source: this library; answers BKW (2024) §1, second question
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.powEchoProcess_antiClustering_iff.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α γ : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγα : γ < α) {a : ℕ → ℝ} {τ : ℝ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ)
  (hτ :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        ↑n * P.real {ω | a n < ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z 0 ω})
      Filter.atTop (nhds τ))
  {ρ : ℝ} (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hρ : ρ ≠ γ / α) {r : ℕ → ℕ}
  (hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log ↑(r n) / Real.log ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds ρ)) :
  ExtremeValueTheory.AntiClustering P
      (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) a r ↔
    ρ < γ / α
scope_note: An example for every cutoff in (0,1). The critical rho = gamma/alpha is excluded here and treated by power-echo-critical. Novelty is a literature check, not a theorem.

name: Polynomial block-length transition of the power-lag echo
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.powEchoProcess_polyBlocks.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α γ : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγα : γ < α) {u : ℕ → ℝ} {τ : ℝ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ)
  (hτ :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z 0 ω})
      Filter.atTop (nhds τ))
  {ρ : ℝ} (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) {r : ℕ → ℕ}
  (hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log ↑(r n) / Real.log ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds ρ)) :
  (ρ < γ / α →
      Filter.Tendsto
          (ExtremeValueTheory.clusterRatio P
            (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 1) ∧
        ExtremeValueTheory.AntiClusteringAt P
          (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r) ∧
    (γ / α < ρ →
      Filter.Tendsto
          (ExtremeValueTheory.clusterRatio P
            (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 2)) ∧
        ¬ExtremeValueTheory.ForwardAntiClusteringAt P
            (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r)
scope_note: log r_n / log n -> rho in (0,1); the boundary rho = gamma/alpha is left out of both cases.

name: The critical block length r_n ~ c n^(gamma/alpha)
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.powEchoProcess_critical.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α γ : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγα : γ < α) {u : ℕ → ℝ} {τ : ℝ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ)
  (hτ :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z 0 ω})
      Filter.atTop (nhds τ))
  {r : ℕ → ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
  (hrc : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / ↑n ^ (γ / α)) Filter.atTop (nhds c)) :
  Filter.Tendsto
      (ExtremeValueTheory.clusterRatio P
        (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r)
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((1 + ExtremeValueTheory.echoShape (α / γ) ((2 / τ) ^ (γ / α) / c)) / 2)) ∧
    ExtremeValueTheory.HasLateReturnMass P
        (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r
        ((1 - ExtremeValueTheory.echoShape (α / γ) ((2 / τ) ^ (γ / α) / c)) / 2) ∧
      ((2 / τ) ^ (γ / α) / c < 1 →
          ¬ExtremeValueTheory.ForwardAntiClusteringAt P
              (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r) ∧
        (1 < (2 / τ) ^ (γ / α) / c →
          ExtremeValueTheory.AntiClusteringAt P
            (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r)
scope_note: Anticlustering is decided for kappa != 1 only; at kappa = 1 it stays open, though the limits are given.

name: The log-echo process is geometrically beta-mixing
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.betaMixing_logEchoProcess_le.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
  (ProbabilityTheory.betaMixing
        (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k) P h).toReal ≤
    2 * (2 ^ α * Real.exp α / (1 - Real.exp (-α))) * Real.exp (-α) ^ h
scope_note: An explicit bound for h >= 1, for Pareto noise.

name: Every echo process with E L(Z) < infinity is beta-mixing
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.isBetaMixing_echoProcess.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ}
  {L : ℝ → ℕ} (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hLm : Measurable L)
  (hLsum : Summable fun j => (ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α).real {z | j + 1 ≤ L z}) :
  ProbabilityTheory.IsBetaMixing (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess L Z ↑k) P
scope_note: Pareto noise.

name: Geometric beta-mixing, yet anticlustering and A(u_n) never hold together
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.logEchoProcess_betaMixing_incompatible.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {α : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t))
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) :
  (∀ (h : ℕ),
      1 ≤ h →
        (ProbabilityTheory.betaMixing
              (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k) P h).toReal ≤
          2 * (2 ^ α * Real.exp α / (1 - Real.exp (-α))) * Real.exp (-α) ^ h) ∧
    ProbabilityTheory.IsBetaMixing
        (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k) P ∧
      ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ) (τ : ℝ),
        0 < τ →
          Filter.Tendsto
              (fun n =>
                ↑n *
                  P.real {ω | u n < ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z 0 ω})
              Filter.atTop (nhds τ) →
            ∀ (r : ℕ → ℕ),
              Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / Real.log ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                    ExtremeValueTheory.AntiClusteringAt P
                        (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r ∧
                      ¬ExtremeValueTheory.ConditionA
                          (fun k => |ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k|)
                          P u r) ∧
                  (∀ (c : ℝ),
                      0 < c →
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / Real.log ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds c) →
                          ¬ExtremeValueTheory.ConditionA
                              (fun k =>
                                |ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k|)
                              P u r) ∧
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log ↑n / ↑(r n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                        ExtremeValueTheory.ConditionA
                            (fun k =>
                              |ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k|)
                            P u r ∧
                          ¬ExtremeValueTheory.ForwardAntiClusteringAt P
                              (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r)
scope_note: An example, for the block scales r_n = o(log n), r_n ~ c log n, and log n = o(r_n), r_n = o(n).

name: Power-lag echo: anticlustering and A(u_n) never hold together
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.powEchoProcess_not_conditionA_and_antiClustering.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {α γ : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t))
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγα : γ < α) {u : ℕ → ℝ} {τ : ℝ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ)
  (hτ :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z 0 ω})
      Filter.atTop (nhds τ))
  {ρ : ℝ} (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hρ : ρ ≠ γ / α) {r : ℕ → ℕ}
  (hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log ↑(r n) / Real.log ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds ρ)) :
  ProbabilityTheory.IsBetaMixing
      (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z ↑k) P ∧
    (ExtremeValueTheory.AntiClusteringAt P
          (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r ↔

            (fun k => |ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z ↑k|) P u r ∧

            (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess (ExtremeValueTheory.powLag γ) Z) u r)

name: A(u_n) is necessary in theta-equals-vartheta
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.scaleMixture_needs_conditionA.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {α c : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ} {E : Set Ω} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
  (hEZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.Indep (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom {E})
      (ExtremeValueTheory.innovationSigma Z) P)
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1) (hp0 : 0 < P.real E)
  (hp1 : P.real E < 1) :
  ExtremeValueTheory.HasShiftInvariantWindows P (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.scaleMixture E c Z) ∧
    ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralTailProcess P (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.scaleMixture E c Z) α
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ()) ExtremeValueTheory.unitSpectral ∧
      (ExtremeValueTheory.candidateExtremalIndex (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ())
              ExtremeValueTheory.unitSpectral α).toReal =
          1 ∧
        (∀ τ > 0,
            ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ),
              Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun n =>
                    ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < |ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.scaleMixture E c Z 0 ω|})
                  Filter.atTop (nhds τ) →
                ∀ (r : ℕ → ℕ),
                  Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
                    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                      ExtremeValueTheory.AntiClusteringAt P
                          (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.scaleMixture E c Z) u r ∧
                        ¬ExtremeValueTheory.ConditionA
                            (fun k => |ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.scaleMixture E c Z ↑k|) P u
                            r) ∧
          ∀ (θ : ℝ),
            ¬ExtremeValueTheory.HasExtremalIndex
                (fun k => |ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.scaleMixture E c Z ↑k|) P θ
scope_note: A counterexample.

name: D'(u_n) is necessary in Leadbetter's theorem
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.leadbetter_needs_conditionD'.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {Z : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hZ : ∀ (t : ℕ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hid : ∀ (t : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (Z t) (Z 0) P P)
  (hcont : Continuous fun x => P.real {ω | Z 0 ω ≤ x}) {τ : ℝ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ) :
  ∃ u,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < max (Z 0 ω) (Z (0 + 1) ω)}) Filter.atTop
        (nhds τ) ∧
      ProbabilityTheory.IsStationary (fun t ω => max (Z t ω) (Z (t + 1) ω)) P ∧
        ExtremeValueTheory.ConditionD (fun t ω => max (Z t ω) (Z (t + 1) ω)) P u ∧
          ¬ExtremeValueTheory.ConditionD' (fun t ω => max (Z t ω) (Z (t + 1) ω)) P u ∧
            ¬Filter.Tendsto
                (fun n =>
                  P.real
                    {ω |
                      ExtremeValueTheory.partialMax (fun t ω => max (Z t ω) (Z (t + 1) ω)) n ω ≤
                        u n})
                Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp (-τ)))
scope_note: A counterexample: the moving maximum of iid noise with continuous marginal.

name: The mixing condition cannot be dropped from the mixing Hill theorem
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.mixture_hill_needs_mixing.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {α : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ} {E : Set Ω} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
  (hEZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.Indep (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom {E})
      (ExtremeValueTheory.innovationSigma Z) P)
  (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hp0 : 0 < P.real E) {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  ProbabilityTheory.IsStationary (fun n ω => ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z (↑n) ω) P ∧
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying
        (fun x => (P {ω | x < ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z (↑0) ω}).toReal) (-α) ∧
      (∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
          0 < c →
            Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
              Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun n =>
                    ↑n * (P {ω | u n < ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z (↑0) ω}).toReal /
                      ↑(k n))
                  Filter.atTop (nhds c) →
                Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun n =>
                    (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ((fun x => 0) n),
                          P.real
                            {ω |
                              u n < ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z (↑0) ω ∧
                                u n < ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z (↑h) ω}) /
                        (P {ω | u n < ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z (↑0) ω}).toReal /
                      ↑(k n))
                  Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
        (¬MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P
              (fun n ω =>
                ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z (↑↑i) ω)
                  (k n))
              Filter.atTop fun x => 1 / α) ∧
          ¬Filter.Tendsto
              (fun n =>
                ↑n / ↑(k n) ^ 2 *
                  ∑ h ∈ Finset.Ico ((fun x => 0) n + 1) n,
                    (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing
                        (fun n ω => ExtremeValueTheory.mixtureProcess E Z (↑n) ω) P h).toReal)
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
scope_note: A counterexample, for the constant/iid mixture.

name: Geometric strong mixing does not give theta = candidate index
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.logEcho_alphaMixing_theta_ne_vartheta.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {α : ℝ} {Z : ℤ → Ω → ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hZ : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Z t))
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Z P)
  (hlaw : ∀ (t : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z t) P = ProbabilityTheory.paretoMeasure 1 α)
  (hpos : ∀ (t : ℤ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ Z t ω) :
  ProbabilityTheory.IsStrongMixing
      (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k) P ∧
    (∀ (h : ℕ),
        1 ≤ h →
          (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing
                (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k) P
                h).toReal ≤
            2 * (2 ^ α * Real.exp α / (1 - Real.exp (-α))) * Real.exp (-α) ^ h) ∧
      ExtremeValueTheory.HasShiftInvariantWindows P
          (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) ∧
        ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralTailProcess P
            (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) α
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ()) ExtremeValueTheory.unitSpectral ∧
          (ExtremeValueTheory.candidateExtremalIndex (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ())
                  ExtremeValueTheory.unitSpectral α).toReal =
              1 ∧
            ExtremeValueTheory.HasExtremalIndex
                (fun k => ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k) P (1 / 2) ∧
              ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ) (τ : ℝ),
                0 < τ →
                  Filter.Tendsto
                      (fun n =>
                        ↑n *
                          P.real
                            {ω |
                              u n < ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z 0 ω})
                      Filter.atTop (nhds τ) →
                    ∀ (r : ℕ → ℕ),
                      Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log ↑n / ↑(r n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                            ExtremeValueTheory.ConditionA
                                (fun k =>
                                  |ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z ↑k|)
                                P u r ∧
                              ¬ExtremeValueTheory.ForwardAntiClusteringAt P
                                  (ExtremeValueTheory.echoProcess ExtremeValueTheory.logLag Z) u r
scope_note: A counterexample: anticlustering does not follow from mixing.

name: E Y^alpha < infinity is not enough in Breiman's lemma
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breiman_counterexample {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) :
  Measurable (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanX α) ∧
    Measurable (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanY α) ∧
      ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanX α)
          (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanY α) ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanP ∧
        (∀ᵐ (ω : ℝ × ℝ) ∂ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanP,
            0 ≤ ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanY α ω) ∧
          ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying
              (fun x =>
                (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanP
                    {ω | x < ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanX α ω}).toReal)
              (-α) ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanY α ω ^ α)
                ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanP ∧
              Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun x =>
                    (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanP
                          {ω |
                            x <
                              ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanX α ω *
                                ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanY α ω}).toReal /
                      (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanP
                          {ω | x < ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanX α ω}).toReal)
                  Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
                ∀ (L : ℝ),
                  ¬Filter.Tendsto
                      (fun x =>
                        (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanP
                              {ω |
                                x <
                                  ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanX α ω *
                                    ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanY α ω}).toReal /
                          (ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanP
                              {ω | x < ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.breimanX α ω}).toReal)
                      Filter.atTop (nhds L)
scope_note: A counterexample for every alpha > 0.

name: Breiman's lemma with E Y^alpha < infinity for asymptotically Pareto tails
scope_note: Only tails with x^alpha P(X > x) -> c > 0, not general regular variation, which is what makes the weaker moment enough; see breiman-counterexample.

name: Tail balance is necessary for the generalized CLT
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.not_tendsto_of_not_tailBalance {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα2 : α < 2)
  (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (ExtremeValueTheory.absTail μ) (-α))
  (hnb :
    ¬∃ p,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun x => μ.real (Set.Ioi x) / ExtremeValueTheory.absTail μ x) Filter.atTop
          (nhds p))
  {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < a n) {ν : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure ℝ}
  (hnd : ∀ (x : ℝ), ↑ν ≠ MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x) :
  ¬Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x => (a n)⁻¹ * (x - b n))
            (ExtremeValueTheory.Subexp.convPow μ n),
          ⋯⟩)
      Filter.atTop (nhds ν)
scope_note: Also follows from gclt-converse; stated directly.

name: The no-atom hypothesis of the finite-endpoint von Mises theorem is necessary
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.atomCDF_vonMises_counterexample :
  (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1,
      HasDerivAt (↑ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.atomCDF.toStieltjesFunction) (Real.exp (-x)) x) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.exp (-t)) (-Real.exp (-x)) x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, 0 < Real.exp (-x)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto
            (fun t =>
              (1 - ↑ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.atomCDF.toStieltjesFunction t) * -Real.exp (-t) /
                Real.exp (-t) ^ 2)
            (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)) (nhds (-1)) ∧
          ¬Filter.Tendsto (↑ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.atomCDF.toStieltjesFunction)
                (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)) (nhds 1) ∧
            ¬ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.atomCDF.IsInMDAGumbel ∧
              ¬Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun t =>
                    (1 -
                        ↑ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.atomCDF.toStieltjesFunction
                          (t +
                            1 *
                              ((1 - ↑ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.atomCDF.toStieltjesFunction t) /
                                Real.exp (-t)))) /
                      (1 - ↑ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.atomCDF.toStieltjesFunction t))
                  (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)) (nhds (Real.exp (-1)))
scope_note: A counterexample.

name: Karamata's tail-integral limit fails for alpha < 1
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.Minimality.not_tendsto_integral_Ioi_div_of_lt_one {F : ℝ → ℝ} {α : ℝ}
  (hF : Antitone F) (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying F (-α)) (hα : α < 1) :
  ¬Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi x, F t) / (x * F x)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (1 / (α - 1)))
scope_note: Only antitone F: the docstring and RESEARCH.md say 'every F', but the statement assumes F antitone. alpha = 1 is a separate theorem.
